errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the values for the Law line at 2^10 and 2^11. The plot shows the Law line is at ~5.1 at 2^10 (not 4.3) and dips to ~4.7 at 2^11 (not 5.1). The value 4.3 belongs to the Intent line at that x-coordinate.

In the description of the Translation line (purple), it is stated that it dips to about 4.7 at 2^11. However, the plot shows the purple line at a value of ~5.6 at this point. The value 4.7 corresponds to the Law line (gold) at that same x-coordinate.
In the description of the Math line (green), it is stated that the value is about 4.7 at 2^11. The plot shows the green line is at approximately 5.0 at this x-coordinate.
The description states the Translation line (purple) ends around 6.0. The plot shows it ending visibly below 6.0, at approximately 5.9.

errors.evidence: The description attempts to list the value for nearly every data point for all six lines, resulting in an extremely long and dense sentence that is difficult to read and process. A more summarized description of trends with key points would be clearer.
